steps.title: Mode-to-plugin mapping
steps.note: The executor maps canonical modes like research, code, and data to plugin IDs. If no plugin is mapped, the executor falls back to inline handlers such as docs or data.

steps.title: Mode-to-artifact kind
steps.note: Each mode declares the artifact kind it produces. This lets downstream UI components render the result with the correct viewer: document, spreadsheet, website, image, video, or code.

steps.title: Execute agent mode
steps.note: executeAgentMode receives the mode id, prompt, optional template title, and callbacks. It emits a tool-call event so the rest of the surface can observe the run.

steps.title: Dispatch to plugin or inline handler
steps.note: The executor selects the plugin instance, wires abort handling, and runs the plugin. Docs and sheets use dedicated prompts, while other modes delegate to the plugin runtime.

steps.title: Emit result and artifact
steps.note: After the plugin succeeds, the executor emits the tool result and builds an ArtifactUIPart with the primary content. The MODE_EXECUTION_COMPLETE marker is sent through the chunk callback.
